styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Skanderbeg Square, the Pyramid and Blloku's cafés.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Bunk'Art, the National History Museum and Ottoman relics.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Byrek, tavë kosi and long café mornings.

stays.why: Walk to the main sights, museums and the airport bus; best for a first short stay.
Bars, restaurants and cafés on your doorstep; lively at night, a short walk to the centre.
Quieter street with mid-range hotels; 10–15 minutes on foot to the square.
Local, cheaper and near the big park and cable car; use buses or taxis to the centre.

food: Start the day with byrek (flaky pastry with cheese or spinach) and a strong coffee, roughly 100–200 lek.
Try tavë kosi (baked lamb with yogurt) and fërgesë (peppers, tomato and cheese) at a traditional restaurant.
Blloku has the densest cluster of cafés and restaurants; walk a block off the main street for better prices.
Cheap eats: grilled meat, suflaqe (wraps) and bakery snacks for about 300–600 lek a meal.
Coffee culture is serious here. A macchiato at a local bar is often under 100 lek; sit and linger.
more_time: Swap a city day for Krujë: buses run from the north terminal, about an hour each way, for the castle and old bazaar. Check times on the day.
Add a day trip to Berat or Gjirokastër by bus or hired car; both are long day trips, so an overnight is better.
Ride the Dajti Ekspres cable car from the east edge of the city for views over Tirana; check opening hours on the day.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the square, Bunk'Art and Blloku at an easy pace; add a third for a day trip to Krujë or the cable car.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs near 11°C, lows near 2°C, and about 12 rain days. Pack a warm coat.
Still chilly at about 14°C highs; rain on roughly 10 days. Good for museums.
Mild at 16°C highs, but one of the wettest months with about 12 rain days. Bring an umbrella.
Spring warms to 19°C highs with about 11 rain days. Pleasant for walking.
Warm at 23°C highs; the wettest month with about 14 rain days. Keep plans flexible.
Early summer: 28°C highs, only about 7 rain days. Long café evenings.
Hot and dry: 32°C highs, about 4 rain days. Sightsee early morning and evening.
Hot like July: 32°C highs, about 5 rain days. Stay hydrated and seek shade at midday.
Warm and comfortable: 27°C highs, about 8 rain days. A strong month to visit.
Mild at 22°C highs with about 9 rain days. Good for walking and day trips.
Cooler at 17°C highs, about 11 rain days. Bring a jacket for evenings.
Cold again: 13°C highs, lows near 4°C, about 10 rain days. Winter coat needed.

climate_guide.summary: Mediterranean with hot, dry summers and cool, wet winters. Spring and autumn are the sweet spots.

items.title: Best time: May to June and September to October
items.text: Highs of 22–28°C and fewer rainy days. Ideal for walking the centre and day trips.

items.title: July and August are hot
items.text: Highs around 32°C and lows near 20°C. Do sights in the morning, rest at midday, go out in the evening.

items.title: Wettest in autumn and early spring
items.text: May and November see about 11–14 rain days. Showers are often short; carry a small umbrella.

items.title: Cool winters
items.text: December to February highs of 11–14°C and lows near 2–4°C. Pack layers and a warm coat.

items.title: Rain is spread across the year
items.text: No month is fully dry. Even summer has a few wet days, so a light rain jacket helps.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Comfortable shoes for uneven sidewalks, layers for cool evenings, sunscreen for summer, and an umbrella in spring and autumn.

transit.best: Walk the compact centre; use taxis or ride apps for longer hops and buses to save money.

modes.text: No metro or tram. Don't plan around rail inside the city.
City buses are the main public transport. A single ticket costs 40 lek, sold on board by a conductor.
Flag-fall 300 lek; a cross-town ride is 400–800 lek. Demand the meter. Apps like Speed Taxi, Patoko, Clust and VrapOn work like Uber.
Useful for day trips outside the city. Traffic in the centre is busy; check parking at your hotel.
Best way to see the compact centre. Sidewalks can be uneven, so watch your step.
Bike lanes exist on some main streets, but cycling can be risky due to traffic.
